about.title: No master plan. Just a lot of tabs.
paragraphs: I'm n4vvii, an indie developer in Japan. I use Vibe Coding to turn random sparks into things I can click, share, or keep tinkering with.
This page is less of a résumé and more of a small window into that process. If something here makes you curious, that is probably enough.
about.calloutNote: Good enough is a perfectly good place to start.
